items.text: Patriots ruled out RB TreVeyon Henderson for Sunday’s game in Germany against the Lions (illness).
items.implication: Misses Week 10; NE backfield thins further with Stevenson concerns
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining NE RBs (e.g. handcuffs/backups)

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay said the team will not place Puka Nacua on IR due to roster mechanics, but he will still be out for a significant period of time (optimistic return Week 14/15). Change from earlier likely-IR reports.
items.why: Roster activation limits; MCL/PCL sprains + turf toe
items.implication: Misses multiple weeks including fantasy-relevant stretch; saves IR activation
items.opportunity: Rams lean run-heavy (negative PROE); elevated snaps/targets for remaining WRs and Kyren Williams carries

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will have surgery later this week on broken ring finger; could return as quickly as 2-3 weeks. IR not guaranteed (decide Saturday). Out vs Vikings before bye.
items.implication: Misses Week 10 at minimum; short-term absence possible without IR
items.opportunity: Elevated role for GB backup RBs (e.g. Chris Brooks, others)

items.text: Scenarios exist where Davante Adams (hamstring) plays and Puka Nacua does not for key fantasy weeks. McVay optimistic Adams return sooner rather than later, realistic after Green Bay (Week 13).
items.implication: Potential WR boost mid-stretch; Adams/Nacua staggered returns
items.opportunity: Adams targets/routes upon return; Rams pass game recovery

items.text: Chiefs listed QB Patrick Mahomes as a full participant in today’s practice, putting him on track to play Sunday at Atlanta.
items.implication: Expected to start Week 10; stabilizes KC offense
items.opportunity: Full snaps for Mahomes and pass-catchers including new Downs

items.text: Vikings positive PROE despite bad QB play; expect pass rate spike with Kirk Cousins. Kevin O'Connell wants to throw. Jefferson major beneficiary.
items.why: PROE data + Cousins familiarity with O'Connell scheme; historical Jefferson production
items.implication: Jefferson back to WR1 territory; more pass volume
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes/snaps for Jefferson and Addison; higher PROE

items.text: Expecting Rams to lean more negative PROE (run-oriented) while without both Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring). No. 9 OL helps run game.
items.why: Pass-game injuries force defensive/run lean; Thorn midseason OL ranks
items.implication: Fewer pass attempts; elevated RB opportunity, suppressed WR volume short-term
items.opportunity: Kyren Williams more carries/snaps; goal-line/red-zone RB work

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE/upgrade with Kirk Cousins back in Minnesota. Averaged 19.6 PPR across 54 games with Cousins historically. Confetti for Jefferson managers.
items.why: Historical production split; Cousins upgrade over recent MIN QBs
items.implication: Start with confidence; WR1 upside restored
items.opportunity: Higher target share and efficiency expected

items.text: Vikings acquire Kirk Cousins: immediate upgrade for pass catchers. Jefferson vaults to WR1 (historical 106+ ypg with Cousins). Expect more pass volume. Raiders Mendoza: Bowers still elite TE1 but lower floor; Jeanty biggest loser (checkdowns).
items.why: Cousins EPA/YPA upgrade; scheme familiarity; Mendoza rookie adjustment
items.implication: Jefferson/Addison up; LV volume/efficiency down short-term
items.opportunity: MIN pass spike (targets/routes); Jeanty TPRR hit possible

items.text: Keeping it OPEN on Jadarian Price even with Charbonnet back. Do not close the door on the rookie opportunity.
items.why: Prior usage/opportunity even if Charbonnet returns
items.implication: Roster/stash; potential committee or standalone value

items.text: Worried about Brock Bowers with Fernando Mendoza at QB? Bowers put up monster numbers as rookie with O'Connell/Minshew/Ridder. He'll be just fine.
items.why: Proven production with multiple QBs; elite talent/matchup nightmare
items.implication: TE1 remains startable; floor lower but still high volume
items.opportunity: Continued high target share even with rookie QB growing pains
items.conflict: ETR notes some floor drop and Jeanty checkdown hit

items.text: Even with CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, still pick up Ryan Flournoy. Room for him in the Cowboys offense and on fantasy rosters.
items.why: Offense has snaps/targets available beyond top two
items.implication: Depth add with upside in DAL pass game

items.text: Pop Douglas (Caleb Douglas) still available in 54% of leagues. 80% route share last two games. Pick up and fine starting in a pinch vs Detroit.
items.implication: Add for depth/flex; startable this week
items.opportunity: 80% routes = clear opportunity in MIA offense

items.text: Week 10 Waiver Wire includes injury report context, FAAB, drops, streamers. Key injuries (Nacua, Jacobs, Henderson etc.) create beneficiary opportunities on wire.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry/target increases for backups of OUT players
